The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Fragrant Mushroom Sautés are a meal that can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Goron Spice]] with [[Mushroom]]s together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Regular Fragrant Mushroom Sautés can be made by using a [[Hylian Shroom]] in the recipe or by using multiple mushrooms with differing effects. Eating them will heal some of [[Link]]'s missing [[Heart]]s. The aroma of these dishes make mouths water. Fragrant Mushroom Sautés are favored by [[Nellie]], a resident of [[Gerudo Town]], who makes it whenever she is feeling tired.{{Cite|My mom often said that dishes with mushrooms were good for nursing serious headaches. So... when I'm feeling tired, I always make {{Color BotW|Blue|fragrant mushroom sauté}}. I love that curry flavour! It's a simple dish that you can make if you have some {{Color BotW|Blue|Goron spice}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|mushrooms}}.|Nellie|BotW}} Based on the types of Mushrooms used, several different variations of Fragrant Mushroom Sauté exist: * '''Hearty Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hearty Truffle]]s or [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s. Eating them will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum hearts. * '''Energizing Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Stamella Shroom]]s. When eaten, they will refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Endura Shroom]]s. They completely refill Link's Stamina Wheel when consumed. * '''Hasty Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Grants a mid-level movement-speed boost.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Rushroom]]s. If they are eaten, they will temporarily boost Link's movement speed. * '''Spicy Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Sunshroom]]s. Consuming one will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] for a short period of time. * '''Electro Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Zapshroom]]s. Eating them gives Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Razorshroom]]s. When eaten, they will temporarily increase the damage of Link's attacks. * '''Tough Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Ironshroom]]s. If they are eaten, Link's defense will be boosted for a short period of time. * '''Sneaky Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Silent Shroom]]s. Eating one increases Link's [[Stealth]] for a time. * '''Chilly Fragrant Mushroom Sauté''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Fragrant Mushroom Sauté}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The fragrant aroma of this sautéed spice and mushroom dish makes your mouth water.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Chillshroom]]s. When consumed, Link will temporarily gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Herb Sauté * Meal * Sautéed Nuts * Sautéed Peppers }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
